traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Order meets disruption. The clash of the established and the radical, the structured and the new. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Restlessness fights control; each demands attention and sabotages the other until both are satisfied at once. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

readerCopy.summary: A rigid institution keeps enforcing a process that technology, staff, or public need has already made obsolete.
readerCopy.body: A rigid institution keeps enforcing a process that technology, staff, or public need has already made obsolete. Workers build unofficial workarounds, users keep finding gaps, and leadership responds by tightening the same rules creating the delay. Saturn protects the established structure and chain of responsibility, while Uranus keeps exposing where the structure can no longer contain reality. The square turns every attempted workaround into another confrontation over who is authorized to change the system. Reform may be unavoidable, but the people trapped inside the transition pay for every month authority refuses to admit the old process has failed.
